settings.desc_body:
Nimbus is the piece most aligned with the concept. Its name comes from the dark clouds that signal rain, and its design is inspired by the simple shapes of clouds found in children's drawings.

The velvet bag is washable and handmade, while the case is manufactured through 3D printing. It features an interchangeable, customizable template.

Nimbus Grey owes its name to cumulonimbus clouds, the dark clouds that signal rain. Its design is inspired by the simple shapes of clouds found in children's drawings.

The velvet bag is washable and handmade, while the case is manufactured through 3D printing. It features an interchangeable, customizable insert.

The Nimbus Triple White features a white case and a matching keychain. Although the velvet bag is interchangeable, the original combination was designed to achieve a fully white look.
The velvet bag is washable and handmade, while the case is manufactured through 3D printing. It features an interchangeable, customizable insert.

settings.materials: Crafted with a 3D-printed case, a handmade washable velvet pouch, metal hardware, and a signature branded keychain.
settings.shipping: Standard shipping within 5–7 business days. Free shipping on orders over €200. Returns accepted within 14 days of delivery.
settings.shipping_note: Envío gratuito en pedidos superiores a €200
